changelog: Primeira build do CelerOS para o cao robotico SpotBear/ZZPET (board spotpear-dog): OLED SH1106, servos das pernas, microfone, alto-falante I2S, fitas WS2812 e bateria.
guide: Updates install directly on the device: open Settings > System Updates and tap INSTALL. Alternatively open the web file manager and use Firmware Update.
